input_length_reference: Primary hybrid closed_c1_r1/r2/r3 development request arrivals, using the fixed original character-length deciles

recovery.baseline: Same burst run's normal phase if at least 10 requests succeed; otherwise the primary hybrid closed C1 three-repeat reference
recovery.queue_band: max(100 ms, 1.10 times successful baseline queue-wait P95)
recovery.request_order: Scheduled arrival order within the recovery phase
recovery.failure_rule: Any failed request or observation outside either band resets the sequence
recovery.time_report: First request observed in band; confirmation only after all three consecutive in-band requests have completed
recovery.interpretation: Three-request recovery is this experiment's declared operational observation rule, not a business SLA, statistical confidence interval, or proof of sustained future recovery. Low sample counts can leave recovery unconfirmed.

label_use: Labels are joined only after each run is completed, solely for development-replay diagnostics; never used to select the JS threshold, long-text examples or recovery bands
deduplication: Quality uses unique source review identities within a reported scope; HTTP availability uses every attempted request. The same reviews can recur across windows, so window counts do not create independent new samples.
drift_interpretation: Input or prediction distribution changes are proxy signals and cannot be equated with F1 degradation. F1 differences across phases may reflect input composition rather than changing model parameters.
